findings.message: No discrete CC pulldown (Rd) is visible on the receptacle. If a USB-C PD controller / sink IC (e.g. STUSB4500, FUSB302, CYPD) provides Rd internally this is correct — hauksbee cannot see termination inside an IC, so it cannot confirm it from copper.
findings.plain: No discrete CC pulldown (Rd) is visible on the receptacle. If a USB-C PD controller / sink IC (e.g. STUSB4500, FUSB302, CYPD) provides Rd internally this is correct — hauksbee cannot see termination inside an IC, so it cannot confirm it from copper.
